name: Family Favourites (Netherlands)
summary: The 50 dishes Dutch families most like to put on the table on weekdays.

recipes.name: Spaghetti bolognese
steps: Chop the onion and dice the carrot and celery finely.
Brown the mince in the oil until crumbly, add the vegetables and fry for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato purée, add the chopped tomatoes and herbs and simmer gently for 25 minutes.
Meanwhile cook the spaghetti until al dente.
Season the sauce and serve with the spaghetti and cheese.

recipes.name: Lasagne
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Chop the onion and garlic.
Brown the mince in the oil with the onion and garlic and add the pasta sauce.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and gradually whisk in the milk to make a smooth white sauce.
Layer meat sauce, lasagne sheets and white sauce in an ovenproof dish, finishing with white sauce and cheese.
Bake for 35 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Chilli con carne
steps: Chop the onion and garlic and dice the peppers.
Brown the mince in the oil, add the onion, garlic and spices and fry for 2 minutes.
Add the peppers and chopped tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile cook the rice.
Stir in the drained beans and sweetcorn, heat through for 5 minutes and serve with rice and cheese.

recipes.name: Beef mince wraps
steps: Chop the onion and fry it in the oil until soft.
Add the mince and brown it; stir in the tomato purée, spices and a splash of water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Shred the lettuce, slice the tomatoes and warm the wraps briefly in the oven or a pan.
Put everything on the table and let everyone fill their own wrap with mince, vegetables, cheese and sauce.

recipes.name: Steak with fried potatoes and green beans
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and slice.
Fry the potato slices with the chopped onion in the oil until golden and crisp.
Cook the green beans for 8 minutes until tender.
Season the steaks and fry them in hot butter for 2–3 minutes per side.
Rest the steaks briefly and serve with the pan juices, potatoes and beans.

recipes.name: Hamburgers
steps: Season the mince and shape it into 4 flat burgers.
Fry the burgers in the oil for 4 minutes per side, adding a slice of cheese for the last minute.
Slice the tomatoes and toast the buns briefly.
Fill the buns with lettuce, burger, tomato, relish, mayonnaise and ketchup.

recipes.name: Dutch meatballs with gravy, potatoes and green beans
ingredients: 500 g mixed beef and pork mince
steps: Soak the bread in the milk and chop the onion finely.
Mix the mince with the bread, egg, onion, nutmeg, salt and pepper, shape into 4 balls and roll them in the breadcrumbs.
Brown the meatballs all over in the butter, add a splash of water and cook gently, covered, for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes and green beans until tender.
Serve the meatballs with the gravy from the pan, potatoes and beans.

recipes.name: Broccoli and beef mince bake
steps: Boil the potatoes and mash them with the butter, milk, nutmeg and salt.
Preheat the oven to 200°C and cook the broccoli florets for 4 minutes.
Fry the onion and garlic in the oil, add the mince and brown it; stir in the tomato purée.
Spoon the mince and broccoli into an ovenproof dish, spread the mash on top and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake for 30 minutes until the cheese is golden.

recipes.name: Vegetable soup with meatballs
steps: Bring the water to the boil with the stock cubes.
Cut the potatoes, carrots, leek and beans into small pieces and simmer them in the stock for 10 minutes.
Mix the mince with the herbs, salt and pepper and roll into small meatballs.
Simmer the meatballs in the soup for 8 minutes.
Season, sprinkle with celery leaves and serve with bread.

recipes.name: Hachee (Dutch beef and onion stew) with potatoes and red cabbage
steps: Cut the beef into large chunks and slice the onions into half-rings.
Brown the beef in the butter, add the onions and fry until soft.
Sprinkle over the flour, stir well and add the water, stock cube, vinegar, bay leaves and cloves.
Simmer very gently, covered, for about 3 hours until the meat falls apart.
Boil the potatoes, heat the red cabbage and serve with the hachee.

recipes.name: Boerenkool stamppot (kale mash) with smoked sausage
steps: Peel and chop the potatoes and boil them with the kale on top for 20 minutes until tender.
Heat the sausage in hot water for 15 minutes without boiling.
Drain the potatoes and kale and mash with the milk and butter until creamy.
Season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Serve with sliced sausage and mustard.

recipes.name: Hutspot (carrot and onion mash) with pork belly slices
steps: Peel the potatoes and cut the potatoes, carrots and onions into chunks.
Boil everything together in salted water for 20 minutes until tender.
Season the pork belly slices and fry them in the oil until crisp on both sides.
Drain the vegetables and mash coarsely with the milk and butter.
Serve the hutspot with the pork slices and pan juices as gravy.

recipes.name: Zuurkool stamppot (sauerkraut mash) with smoked sausage
steps: Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes, adding the sauerkraut for the last 10 minutes.
Heat the sausage in hot water.
Fry the lardons until crisp and briefly fry the diced apple with them.
Drain the potatoes and sauerkraut and mash with the milk and mustard.
Fold in the bacon and apple and serve with sliced sausage.

recipes.name: Andijvie stamppot (endive mash) with bacon
steps: Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile fry the bacon strips in a dry pan until crisp.
Drain the potatoes and mash with the milk and butter.
Stir the raw endive and half the bacon into the mash.
Season with nutmeg, salt and pepper and scatter the remaining bacon on top.

recipes.name: Slavinken (bacon-wrapped mince rolls) with potatoes, cauliflower and cheese sauce
ingredients: 4 slavinken (minced pork rolls wrapped in bacon)
steps: Boil the potatoes and cauliflower florets separately for 15–20 minutes until tender.
Fry the slavinken in the oil over a medium heat for about 15 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and gradually whisk in the milk until thickened.
Melt the cheese into the sauce and season with nutmeg.
Serve the slavinken with the potatoes and cauliflower in cheese sauce.

recipes.name: Pork chops with fried baby potatoes and red cabbage salad
steps: Parboil the baby potatoes for 10 minutes, then fry them in 1 tbsp herb butter until golden.
Toss the red cabbage, apple strips and raisins with the mayonnaise and vinegar.
Season the pork chops with salt and pepper.
Fry them in the remaining herb butter for 4–5 minutes per side until cooked.
Serve with the potatoes and red cabbage salad.

recipes.name: Macaroni with ham and cheese
steps: Cook the macaroni until al dente and preheat the oven to 200°C.
Fry the onion and pepper in the oil, add the ham, tomato purée, chopped tomatoes and herbs and simmer for 5 minutes.
Mix the sauce with the macaroni and spoon into an ovenproof dish.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake for 15 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Baked chicory with ham and cheese
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Halve the chicory lengthways, cook for 5 minutes and drain well.
Wrap each half in a slice of ham and lay the rolls in an ovenproof dish.
Make a white sauce with the butter, flour and milk and stir in half the cheese and the nutmeg.
Pour the sauce over the chicory, sprinkle with the remaining cheese and bake for 25 minutes.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Erwtensoep (Dutch split pea soup)
steps: Rinse the split peas and bring them to the boil with the water, ribs, stock cubes and bay leaves.
Simmer gently for 60 minutes, stirring now and then.
Dice the carrot, leeks and celeriac, add them and simmer for another 30 minutes.
Take the meat off the ribs and return it to the soup; add the sliced sausage.
Sprinkle with celery leaves and serve with rye bread.

recipes.name: Nasi goreng with ham
steps: Cook the rice and let it cool completely (ideally the day before).
Fry the spice paste briefly in the oil in a wok.
Stir-fry the vegetables for 5 minutes and add the ham.
Add the rice and ketjap and stir-fry until piping hot.
Fry the eggs and serve the nasi topped with a fried egg and prawn crackers.

recipes.name: Boerenomelet (Dutch farmer's omelette)
steps: Fry the lardons in the butter in a large frying pan.
Add the potatoes and fry for 10 minutes until golden.
Add the vegetables and fry for 5 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper and pour over the vegetables.
Let the omelette set over a low heat, covered; sprinkle with chives and serve with bread.

recipes.name: Spaghetti carbonara
steps: Cook the spaghetti until al dente, keeping a cup of the cooking water.
Fry the lardons in the oil until crisp.
Beat the eggs with the cheese and plenty of pepper.
Off the heat, toss the spaghetti with the bacon and egg mixture, adding a little cooking water to make a creamy sauce.
Serve straight away with extra cheese.

recipes.name: Chicken drumsticks with apple sauce and chips
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Rub the drumsticks with the oil, paprika, salt and pepper and place them in an ovenproof dish.
Roast the chicken for 45 minutes, adding the chips for the last 25 minutes.
Cook the peas briefly and stir in the butter.
Serve the chicken and chips with apple sauce, peas and mayonnaise.

recipes.name: Chicken satay with rice and peanut sauce
steps: Cube the chicken and marinate for 10 minutes in the ketjap, curry powder and 1 tbsp oil.
Thread the chicken onto skewers and meanwhile cook the rice.
Cook the green beans for 8 minutes.
Cook the skewers in the remaining oil in a griddle pan for 8–10 minutes, turning, until done.
Warm the satay sauce with a splash of water and serve with rice, beans and prawn crackers.

recipes.name: Bami goreng (Indonesian-style fried noodles) with chicken
ingredients: 200 g white cabbage or bean sprouts
steps: Cook the noodles according to the packet and drain.
Cut the chicken into strips and the leeks into rings; chop the onion and garlic.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil until golden and add the onion, garlic and seasoning mix.
Add the leeks and cabbage and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Add the noodles and ketjap and stir-fry until piping hot.

recipes.name: Chicken curry with rice
steps: Cook the rice and toast the almonds in a dry pan.
Cut the chicken, onion and pepper into pieces.
Brown the chicken in the oil, add the onion and pepper and fry for 3 minutes.
Sprinkle over the curry powder and flour, stir, then gradually add the stock and cream and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve the curry over the rice, sprinkled with almonds.

recipes.name: Chicken schnitzel with fried potatoes and Brussels sprouts
steps: Fry the potato slices with the red onion in 3 tbsp oil for 15 minutes until golden.
Halve the sprouts, boil them for 6 minutes and drain.
Fry the sprouts briefly in a pan with the curry powder.
Fry the schnitzels in the remaining oil for 3–4 minutes per side until cooked.
Serve with the potatoes and sprouts.

recipes.name: Chicken shawarma in pitta
steps: Mix the chicken with the shawarma seasoning.
Fry the chicken with the sliced peppers in the oil for 8 minutes until cooked.
Slice the cucumber, tomatoes and lettuce.
Warm the pittas in the oven for 5 minutes and split them open.
Fill the pittas with lettuce, vegetables and chicken and top with garlic sauce.

recipes.name: Sweet and sour chicken with rice
ingredients: 1 tin halved apricots in syrup (840 g)
steps: Cook the rice.
Cube the chicken and cut the peppers and onion into pieces; drain the apricots, keeping some syrup.
Fry the chicken in the butter until golden and add the peppers and onion for 3 minutes.
Add the curry ketchup, vinegar, 100 ml syrup and the chopped apricots and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve the sweet and sour chicken with rice.

recipes.name: Creamy pasta with chicken and mushrooms
steps: Cook the pasta until al dente.
Cube the chicken, slice the mushrooms and chop the onion and garlic.
Fry the chicken in the oil until golden; add the onion, garlic and mushrooms and fry for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato purée, add the halved tomatoes and the cream and simmer for 5 minutes.
Toss the sauce with the pasta and season.

recipes.name: Chicken, broccoli and potato bake
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C and blanch the broccoli florets for 3 minutes.
Fry the diced chicken with the onion in the oil until golden.
Layer the potato slices, chicken and broccoli in a greased ovenproof dish.
Whisk the cream, egg, salt and pepper, pour over the dish and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake for 40–45 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the cheese is golden.

recipes.name: Chicken teriyaki with noodles
steps: Cook the noodles according to the packet and drain.
Cut the chicken into strips, the pak choi into pieces and the spring onions into rings.
Stir-fry the chicken with the garlic in the oil until golden.
Add the pak choi and spring onions and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Toss in the noodles, teriyaki and soy sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Chicken in mushroom sauce with potatoes and vegetables
steps: Boil the potatoes, broccoli and cauliflower until tender.
Cube the chicken and fry it in the margarine until golden.
Add the sliced mushrooms and fry for 5 minutes.
Pour in the stock and thicken with the cornflour mixed with a little water.
Season and serve with the potatoes and vegetables.

recipes.name: Kibbeling (battered cod bites) with chips and tartare sauce
steps: Bake the chips in the oven according to the packet.
Cut the cod into bite-sized pieces and sprinkle with the fish seasoning.
Whisk the flour, egg, sparkling water and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter.
Heat the oil to 180°C, dip the fish in the batter and deep-fry in batches for 3–4 minutes until golden.
Drain and serve with chips, tartare sauce, lemon and salad.

recipes.name: Fish fingers with potato wedges and broccoli
ingredients: 500 g white fish fillet (pangasius or coley)
steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C. Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with 3 tbsp oil and salt and roast for 30 minutes.
Cut the fish into fingers and coat them in flour, beaten egg and panko.
Place the fish fingers on a baking tray, drizzle with the remaining oil and bake for the last 15 minutes.
Cook the broccoli for 5 minutes.
Mix the yoghurt, mayonnaise and gherkins into a sauce and serve everything together.

recipes.name: Oven-baked salmon with baby potatoes and spinach
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Halve the potatoes, toss with 2 tbsp oil and salt and roast for 25 minutes.
Add the salmon, tomato wedges and mangetout to the tray, drizzle with lemon juice and bake for 15 minutes.
Fry the garlic briefly in the remaining oil and wilt the spinach in it.
Season the spinach with salt and pepper.
Serve the salmon with the potatoes, vegetables and a lemon wedge.

recipes.name: Cod and mash fish pie
steps: Boil the potatoes and mash with the milk, butter, parsley and salt.
Preheat the oven to 200°C. Fry the onion, peppers and courgette in the oil, add the tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Spoon the vegetable sauce into an ovenproof dish and lay the cod pieces on top.
Spread the mash over the fish and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden on top.

recipes.name: Pasta with tuna and tomato sauce
ingredients: 2 tins tuna in water (145 g each)
steps: Cook the pasta until al dente, adding the broccoli florets for the last 4 minutes.
Chop the onion and fry it gently in the oil.
Add the chopped tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir in the drained tuna and heat briefly.
Toss with the pasta and broccoli and serve with cheese.

recipes.name: Tagliatelle with smoked salmon and spinach
steps: Cook the tagliatelle according to the packet, keeping a splash of the cooking water.
Fry the halved tomatoes briefly in the oil.
Wilt the spinach in the pan.
Stir in the cream cheese and a little cooking water to make a creamy sauce.
Toss in the pasta and salmon, season with pepper and serve straight away.

recipes.name: Pan-fried cod with baby potatoes and cucumber salad
steps: Boil the baby potatoes for 15 minutes until tender.
Slice the cucumber and mix it with the yoghurt, chives, salt and pepper.
Sprinkle the cod with the fish seasoning.
Fry the fish in the oil for 3–4 minutes per side until cooked.
Serve the fish with the potatoes, cucumber salad and beetroot.

recipes.name: Pannenkoeken (Dutch pancakes)
steps: Mix the flour and salt, add the eggs and half the milk and whisk to a smooth batter.
Whisk in the rest of the milk and leave the batter to rest for 15 minutes.
Melt a little butter in a frying pan and cook thin pancakes until golden on both sides.
If you like, scatter cheese or thin apple slices over the batter before flipping.
Serve with syrup and icing sugar.

recipes.name: Tomato soup with cheese toasties
steps: Chop the onion and garlic and fry them gently in the oil.
Add the chopped tomatoes, tomato purée and stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend the soup until smooth and season.
Top 4 slices of bread with cheese and mozzarella, cover with the remaining slices and butter the outsides.
Toast the sandwiches in a frying pan or toastie maker until golden and serve with the soup.

recipes.name: Eggs in curry sauce with rice and green beans
steps: Cook the rice and hard-boil the eggs for 8 minutes; peel them.
Cook the green beans for 8 minutes.
Fry the chopped onion in the butter, stir in the curry powder and flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually stir in the stock and coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes until thickened.
Add the halved eggs to the sauce and serve with rice, beans and almonds.

recipes.name: Leek and cheese tart
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C and let the puff pastry thaw.
Line a greased tart tin with the pastry.
Slice the leeks and fry gently in the oil for 5 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the yoghurt, cheese, nutmeg, salt and pepper and stir in the leeks.
Pour the filling into the tin and bake for 40 minutes until set and golden.
Serve with a green salad.

recipes.name: Pizza margherita
steps: Preheat the oven to 230°C and roll the dough out onto two baking trays.
Crush the tomatoes with the garlic, oil, oregano and a pinch of salt to make a sauce.
Spread the sauce over the dough and top with the mozzarella and grated cheese.
Bake for 12–15 minutes until the base is crisp.
Scatter with fresh basil and serve with raw vegetables.

recipes.name: Baked tortelloni with spinach
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C and cook the tortelloni according to the packet.
Fry the garlic in the oil and wilt the spinach in it.
Mix the tortelloni, spinach and soured cream in an ovenproof dish.
Crumb the bread with the pine nuts and cheese and scatter over the dish.
Bake for 10–12 minutes until crisp on top.

recipes.name: Tagliatelle with pesto, mozzarella and cherry tomatoes
steps: Cook the tagliatelle according to the packet.
Halve the tomatoes and tear the mozzarella into pieces.
Drain the pasta and immediately toss it with the pesto.
Fold in the tomatoes, mozzarella and rocket and sprinkle with Parmesan.

recipes.name: Spinach stamppot (mash) with eggs
steps: Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes until tender.
Hard-boil the eggs for 8 minutes and peel them.
Heat the spinach and peas in a pan until thawed and hot.
Drain the potatoes and mash with the milk and butter; stir in the spinach and peas.
Season with nutmeg, salt and pepper and serve with the halved eggs.

recipes.name: Foe yong hai (Dutch-Chinese omelette in sweet tomato sauce) with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Heat the tomato frito, ketchup and ginger syrup in a small pan to make a sweet sauce.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and stir in the peas, spring onions and bean sprouts.
Cook two thick omelettes in the oil over a low heat until set.
Cut into wedges and serve with the sauce and rice.

recipes.name: Stuffed peppers with rice
steps: Cook the rice and preheat the oven to 200°C.
Fry the onion, garlic and diced courgette in the oil; add the vegetarian mince and fry for 5 minutes.
Halve the peppers lengthways and remove the seeds.
Fill the peppers with the mince mixture, sprinkle with cheese and bake for 20 minutes.
Serve with the rice and a dollop of yoghurt.
